purpose: Unified learning rate and dense, RSSE-style trajectory reporting
plot_metric: relative L2 on fixed independent space-time evaluation points
interpolation: linear in log10(metric), only inside recorded coverage; never counts as new observations
uncertainty_band: For two or more matched seeds only: arithmetic mean to mean plus sample standard deviation (ddof=1), explicitly labeled; no confidence-interval claim
single_seed_display: raw curve, explicit n=1, no seed-variability band
provenance_rule: Keep completed sweep artifacts immutable; all three future cases use lr=1e-4; historical plot studies retain their actual learning-rate labels
submission_rule: This file prepares settings for plotting research; it does not submit jobs or extend the completed campaign
